messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for rollout_id=rl-2026-03-17-01 wave=1/4 -> prod-east at 02:15 UTC. Observability hooks enabled. :rocket:
maria: seeing a 503 spike on the canarys in prod-east, starting ~02:18 UTC. 503 rate ~4% -> current traffic is 5% of traffic. link: https://grafana/reports/rl-2026-03-17-01
kevin: @maria can you paste the healthcheck probe logs? if probes are flapping we should hit the kill-switch and stop traffic shift.
maria: logs (tail): ```
[02:18:12] healthcheck: probe failed status=503 target=/health zpool=frontend
[02:18:14] healthcheck: probe ok status=200
[02:18:20] healthcheck: probe failed status=503 target=/health connection_reset
```
kevin: that's noisy. abort criteria threshold is 3% 503 sustained over 2m. i'm going to trigger the feature-flag kill-switch. @deploy-bot please pause wave and rollback canary.
deploy-bot: Kill-switch triggered by kevin. Pausing rollout and initiating rollback for rollout_id=rl-2026-03-17-01. Rolling back wave=1 deployments. ETA ~2m. :warning:
sam: rolling back now, running: `kubectl -n frontends set image deploy/frontend frontend@sha256:oldrev` -> applying rollback.
pagerduty: Pager triggered: rotation=oncall-eng page_id=PD12345 severity=page. Affected customers: none flagged yet.
maria: customer-facing errors look sporadic, no widespread 5xx in metrics across regions yet. I'll keep monitoring.
sre_lead: quick triage: likely change in new image that increased latency on the liveness probe under short bursts. Once rollback completes, confirm canary instances are stable for 10m before rerunning.
maria: rollback completed ~02:22 UTC. healthchecks back to normal. current 503 <0.1%. link: https://grafana/d/snapshot/rl-2026-03-17-01/after-rollback
kevin: good. marking incident as mitigated. opening a short follow-up ticket to capture root cause. please attach failing image diff and e2e test failures. ticket: https://issues/redwood/INC-8421
sam: will keep watch for 30m then hand off. setting handoff note.
morning_oncall: taking handoff at 02:52 UTC. summary: canary wave1 triggered unexpected 503 spike -> abort criteria tripped -> kill-switch and rollback executed by kevin/sam. customer impact minimal, no customer pages after rollback. next steps: collect image diffs, run local probe replay, run load test against health endpoint, schedule postmortem if RCA shows regression.
sre_lead: add owners: maria (investigate probe noise + logs), sam (rollback playbook + validation), kevin (flag gating and rollout thresholds). assign INC-8421.
maria: quick dump of failing container logs attached to ticket. initial suspect: a new dependency timing out under short tcp churn.
kevin: thumbs up. closing on-call thread unless new pages. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Note: automatic canary guardrails recorded event. audit_id=aud-2026-03-17-rl-01.
morning_oncall: acknowledged. I'll kick off a follow-up run and ping infra if probe replay fails.
